title: fix(plugin-detail): record page read mode wraps text values; highlighted dates keep their day
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi999fd6vMjWTq3UYxHRARrsL)_
Fixes #25897

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Ruling (triage 6407256029, verbatim): "Read mode wraps text-like values; truncation only where a layout declares it, with the full value reachable."

- **Details body, read mode** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`). A value the cell table sends to the grid's one-line `TextCellRenderer` (`TruncatedText`: `truncate`, one line, an ellipsis) now reads through `TextField`'s own read display, beside the existing `textarea` branch that reads through `TextAreaField`'s. Matched by renderer identity, like the boolean branch next to it: every type the table maps to the text cell (`text`, `code`, `qrcode`, `time`, `auto_number`) wraps, and a host that registered its own face for one of them keeps it. The value is coerced exactly as `TextCellRenderer` coerced it. `TruncatedText` itself is untouched, so grid cells keep truncating.
- **Highlights strip** (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx`). `date` and `datetime` chips join the wide display types (email, url, phone, textarea) on the 16rem floor. This is the "let the cell grow" arm of the card's expectation. A chip whose line runs out still truncates, with the whole value as its `title`.
- **`scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`**: the registry source hash re-recorded by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (`check-sdui-manifest` hashes every registry source file). `sdui.manifest.json` is byte-identical.
- Changeset: `.changeset/25897-record-read-mode-wraps-text.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch).

## Premise check against main

- Plain `text`: confirmed. `getCellRenderer('text')` is `TextCellRenderer`, which draws `TruncatedText` (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`).
- `textarea`: already wraps on main (the objectui#11577 branch, released in 18.0.0 per the plugin-detail CHANGELOG, pinned by `record-details.textareaReadDisplay-11577`). The card's 18.1.0 reading of the article summary as one line does not reproduce from main for a field declared `textarea`; a summary declared `text` would read exactly as filed, and this PR covers that.
- Highlights datetime: confirmed, measured. A 9rem chip leaves its value about 103px after `px-5` and the separator. Chromium (Inter, 14px semibold, the strip's value face) measured:

| face | width |
|---|---|
| `2026/10/26 上午10:00` (compact datetime, zh-CN) | 154.8px |
| `10/26/2026 10:00 am` (compact datetime, en-US) | 151.2px |
| `Oct 26, 2026, 10:00 AM` (verbose datetime) | 163.9px |
| `2026年10月26日` (date, zh-CN, year always written in the strip) | 114.5px |
| `Oct 26, 2026` (date, en-US) | 89.5px |

Every datetime face overruns the 9rem value box, and so does the zh-CN date face. The 16rem floor leaves 216px. `date` was included as a bounded same-class fix: same defect (a highlighted date losing its day), same file and same one-line rule. `DateTimeCellRenderer` is not changed.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.textReadWraps-25897.test.tsx`: on desktop and mobile, a `text` cell holds exactly `TextField`'s read markup and no one-line utility sits between the drawn subject and the row. An `auto_number` value reads the same way. Controls: the grid's `getCellRenderer('text')` is still `TextCellRenderer` with `truncate` and the full-value `title`, and a host-registered `text` face is kept.
- New `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/HeaderHighlight.dateWideFloor-25897.test.tsx`: `datetime` and `date` chips sit on the 16rem floor. Controls: a plain `text` chip keeps 9rem, and the clip box keeps `truncate` with the whole value as its `title`.
- Updated control in `record-details.textareaReadDisplay-11577.test.tsx`: it pinned "`text` keeps TextCellRenderer", which the ruling reverses. It now pins that a `text` row reads `TextField`'s display and never `TextAreaField`'s.
- Reverse verification (fix committed at 94b2d398, both source files restored from its parent, then restored from HEAD; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards): the three files went to 8 failed / 11 passed. The 8 failures are exactly the new behaviour assertions, and every control stayed green.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` (from `ui/`): Test Files 303 passed, 1 skipped (304); Tests 2822 passed, 18 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check`: exit 0.

## Gates (local, at f1aa0ba6)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 46 derived commands, all run, each exit 0, plus `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` (its roster sits under `.changeset/`), exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` with exit codes recorded: "46 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` was red at 9336bc05, because it hashes every registry source and this PR edits two. It is green after the re-record in f1aa0ba6.
- CI owns the type-check lanes, `Test Core`, the UI lint/type-check/build jobs and the repo-wide scans; they are not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- Residual on the highlights strip: a row narrower than 16rem at `sm` and above (a very narrow host panel) still caps the chip at the row, so the value can truncate there. Below `sm` every chip is a full-width line (objectui#12523).
- The link cells (email, url, phone) in a details section keep their own clip box with a full-value `title` (objectui#12523). That is truncation a renderer declares, with the full value reachable, so it is left as it is.
- `markdown`, `html` and `richtext` read through the rich-text renderers and are not affected.
